subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table (but not necessarily in the same order). Four of them are sitting at the corners while four of them are sitting at the exact centre of the sides. A is on the immediate right of H who is sitting at the exact center of one of the sides of the table. D is an immediate neighbour of A. B is sitting on the immediate right of D. F is the immediate neighbor of B and C. E is sitting to the immediate left of G. Who is sitting to the immediate left of H?
solution:
**Given:**​**​​**

 
• Eight friends— A,B,C,D,E,F,G and H are sitting around a square table facing the center.
 
• four of them sit at four corners of the square while four sit in the middle of each of the four sides.

1)**A is immediate right of H**** who is sitting at the exact center of one of the sides of the table**.** (H is any of the center)**

(observing the direction from center of the square table)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a095eb0f0654249c3f320c4d8a06ea9e400cff072e0efb00fb0e89cfe626d2e.png] 

**2) D is immediate neighbor of A**

(in neighbor of A only one seat is vacant )

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e81c350e71548e2ab54b1809f7b4885ed0c9725a16929c0a87f047e77924ce3.png] 

**3)B is sitting immediate right of D**

 (in neighbor of D only one seat is empty so there is only one possibility)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c262436befff3cc5221c7932fdb3fdb87dcd981612a0425b0b4934e5e34593a.png] 

**4) F is immediate neighbor of B and C**

(this case is only possible when F is in between B and C)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6aea6f3c0fc6dc82fb367bb7929ce67add4200bef0f425e06180006e88fdb9e3.png] 

**5) E is sitting to the immediate left of G**** **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b2c43a5ea6c8b5c590742cc3b089a7995109d635643266f1e41e1c8f80c89dc.png] **

**Thus, G is immediate left of H**.

Hence, the correct answer is** "option 1".**
